variables.artifact_build_symbols_abi: Exact expected and actual artifact bytes, selected build/configuration, symbol addresses, descriptor/function ABI records
variables.cjson: InitHooks/global hook/link write events, well-formed lists at APIs, preexisting allocator hook validity
variables.context: Independently held nine-coordinate property-specific Context; no custody/null context transport
variables.custody: Interceptor-descendant flag, pointer/scalar borrowing, local acquisitions and matched drops before activation return, no retain/transfer/global custody
variables.frames: Loaded-code core/internal writes, public API preconditions, handed-object access and pointer-forgery events
variables.lifetime: Code and opaque-context liveness at each callback including destruction; loader handle references/copies and final close order
variables.plugins: Actual loaded artifact identities and RK/FluentC/FluentGo loader families, including transitive loaded calls
variables.property_view: Exact independently held model source view; no cross-property Context transport
variables.registration: Successful public setters, exact member candidates, list/union-arm/signature candidate inventory and phase/share state
variables.source_binding: C/model and English/formal correspondence remain Open; hashes bind references only
variables.trace: Ordered bounded complete interleaved events, with plugin actor/activation/member/opaque/handle/resource identities; completeness Open
